scope: Bounded public-source review; not exhaustive or independently reproduced

sources.title: ROMA v2
sources.supports: Fixed base weights with writable adapters; custom ROM layout.
sources.limitation: No fabricated ROMA result established; see existing detailed repository review.

sources.title: FixyNN
sources.supports: Fixed vision features with a programmable back end.
sources.limitation: Transfer results cover selected datasets, not arbitrary new tasks.

sources.title: YOLoC
sources.supports: ROM computation plus an SRAM residual branch.
sources.limitation: Different physical implementation from the Basys 3.

sources.title: LogicNets
sources.supports: Sparse quantized networks mapped to truth-table circuits.
sources.limitation: Fan-in growth restricts useful topologies; headline latency is task-specific.

sources.title: hls4ml FAQ
sources.supports: Neural-model conversion and spatial parallelism.
sources.limitation: Layer support and FPGA fit require actual tool evaluation.

sources.title: hls4ml external BRAM weights
sources.supports: Exposed BRAM ports can support a user-built weight loader.
sources.limitation: Documentation flags reimplementation; not a ready-made atomic update system.

sources.title: FINN memory modes
sources.supports: Parameter storage modes depend on layer/backend.
sources.limitation: External storage does not itself guarantee runtime updates for every layer.

sources.title: AMD ROM_STYLE
sources.supports: FPGA ROM can map into BRAM or LUT resources.
sources.limitation: Does not create dense custom mask ROM.

sources.title: Basys 3 reference manual
sources.supports: 1,800 Kbits BRAM and 90 DSP slices.
sources.limitation: Available resources do not imply a full model or sensor interface fits.

sources.title: RNN coupled to SPAD TCSPC for FLIM
sources.supports: Timestamp-to-lifetime processing demonstrated on a Kintex-7 microscope system.
sources.limitation: Specific sensor, estimator, and optical conditions; no Preambl results.

sources.title: FLAN: compact FLIM network
sources.supports: Adder-based lifetime estimation with FPGA implementation.
sources.limitation: Abstract review supports approach, not a fully reproduced performance comparison.

sources.title: Event-driven acquisition
sources.supports: Learned event recognition changes acquisition rate during experiments.
sources.limitation: Actuation and scheduling matter; this is not an FPGA speed demonstration.

sources.title: QubiCML v5
sources.supports: Current abstract reports 40 ns FPGA state inference.
sources.limitation: Core inference differs from readout and complete feedback; older summary reports 54 ns.

sources.title: QICK documentation
sources.supports: RFSoC firmware, software, and real-time control ecosystem.
sources.limitation: Requires supported RFSoC hardware and RF engineering.

sources.title: QubiC project
sources.supports: Existing open FPGA control, gateware, and calibration infrastructure.
sources.limitation: Existing ecosystem, not an unoccupied startup market.

sources.title: Deep calibration transfer
sources.supports: Transfer learning across benchtop and handheld infrared instruments.
sources.limitation: Standard-free does not imply no target data, reference values, or validation.

sources.title: Adaptive ANN calibration transfer
sources.supports: Evaluates adaptation against calibration-transfer alternatives.
sources.limitation: Abstract review; not hardware deployment or universal superiority.

sources.title: Eigenvector datasets
sources.supports: Paired corn spectra and additional spectroscopy/fault datasets.
sources.limitation: Public download does not establish unrestricted redistribution rights.

sources.title: UCI Gas Sensor Array Drift
sources.supports: Sensor measurements organized for drift research; CC BY 4.0.
sources.limitation: Not raw fast acquisition or a real-time FPGA benchmark.

sources.title: EDA data archive
sources.supports: Microscopy recordings and training archive.
sources.limitation: Record predates the final publication; license and split need inspection before reuse.

sources.title: RnnFlim code
sources.supports: Starting point associated with the FLIM paper.
sources.limitation: No reproduction performed; inspect dependencies and license before reuse.

sources.title: EDA code
sources.supports: Existing event-driven microscope-control implementation.
sources.limitation: Hardware compatibility and deployment timing remain setup-specific.

sources.title: Moku Neural Network
sources.supports: Already offers inline neural signal processing and feedback.
sources.limitation: Vendor capability statement; no independent Preambl comparison.

sources.title: Moku neural-model tutorial
sources.supports: Documents feedforward network export, scaling, and clipping.
sources.limitation: Support is platform/version-specific; not evidence of arbitrary model support.

sources.title: Photon Force firmware customization
sources.supports: In-camera processing addresses raw-data transfer constraints.
sources.limitation: Direct overlap; does not establish a need to buy Preambl.

sources.title: Swabian conditional filter
sources.supports: Hardware rules reduce irrelevant time tags before transfer.
sources.limitation: A learned method must improve on appropriate existing rules.

sources.title: ONE WARE
sources.supports: Hardware-targeted vision and OEM deployment offering.
sources.limitation: Marketing/testimonials are not independent benchmarks.

sources.title: ConfigAI
sources.supports: Automated ML-to-FPGA mapping and code generation offering.
sources.limitation: Compilation-time and compatibility claims not independently tested.

sources.title: ZEISS Smart Acquisition Toolkit
sources.supports: Guided acquisition and image-analysis feedback already exist.
sources.limitation: Platform-specific capability; not proof all OEM needs are solved.

sources.title: Pycro-Manager
sources.supports: Microscope automation, image processing, and control components.
sources.limitation: Python orchestration is not a hard real-time timing guarantee.

sources.title: NIREOS HERA
sources.supports: Relevant hyperspectral instrument category for discovery.
sources.limitation: No documented Preambl purchase interest or measured bottleneck.

sources.title: LoRA
sources.supports: Low-rank trainable updates around frozen weights.
sources.limitation: Language-model results do not prove sensor transfer; unmerged adapters add work.

sources.title: TinyTL
sources.supports: Frozen weights with small trainable components for efficient learning.
sources.limitation: Training memory differs from inference memory and circuit area.

sources.title: Tent
sources.supports: Test-time entropy optimization and normalization updates.
sources.limitation: Benchmark success is not a guarantee of stable online instrument adaptation.

sources.title: Neural confidence calibration
sources.supports: Confidence can be miscalibrated; studies temperature scaling.
sources.limitation: Calibrated confidence is not universal out-of-distribution detection.

sources.title: AMD AXI stream handshake
sources.supports: Transfer occurs when valid and ready are both asserted.
sources.limitation: Application must still handle a sensor that cannot pause.

sources.title: DeepFreeze
sources.supports: Fixed-network hardware-generation precedent.
sources.limitation: Research code has documented limitations; no adoption or reproduction here.

sources.title: FixyFPGA
sources.supports: Sparse fixed-weight CNN hardware; pruning/quantization constraints.
sources.limitation: Benefits are design-specific and do not guarantee Basys 3 fit.

sources.title: MemryX FAQ
sources.supports: Model mapping depends on more than parameter capacity.
sources.limitation: Different architecture; benchmark the actual workload before comparing.

sources.title: Mythic M1
sources.supports: On-chip weights and analog inference are existing alternatives.
sources.limitation: Vendor speed/power claims not independently validated here.
